svg.title: Zmbor — PS2 Hardware & Runtime: component status (generated from docs/status/components.json at c7e5960)
svg.text: 174 components · statuses written by hand, checked against cited evidence · evidence commit c7e5960

g.title: ee.alu — Integer ALU, shifts, moves (35 ops) status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: Emitted as C++ on the 64-bit GPR file; 32-bit results sign-extended hardware programs: cpu_ee_alu

ee.trap_arith — Overflow-trapping ADD/ADDI/SUB/DADD/DADDI/DSUB status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Unsigned arithmetic + sign-bit overflow predicate; overflow raises EXCEPTION_INTEGER_OVERFLOW missing: No hardware program names these; exception delivery on overflow only unit-tested
ee.branch — Branches, branch-likely, J/JAL/JR/JALR status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: Exact 64-bit compares, likely-branch delay slots, link registers hardware programs: cpu_ee_branch

ee.branchdelay — Branch and jump in a delay slot status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: The seven cases ps2autotests measures on hardware missing: Architecturally undefined; only the measured combinations are known hardware programs: cpu_ee_branchdelay, cpu_ee_fpu_branchdelay
ee.lsu — Loads and stores, 8 to 128 bit, unaligned forms status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: LWL/LWR/LDL/LDR/SWL/SWR/SDL/SDR, LQ/SQ alignment, PREF hardware programs: cpu_ee_lsu, cpu_ee_lsudelay
ee.muldiv — MULT/DIV, MADD, HI/LO and pipeline 1 status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: Both pipelines (MULT1, DIV1, ...), rd write rules, DIV by zero and INT_MIN/-1 hardware programs: cpu_ee_muldiv
ee.sa — SA register and QFSRV funnel shift status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: MTSA/MTSAB/MTSAH/MFSA byte counts; QFSRV helper hardware programs: cpu_ee_simd_funnel
ee.traps — Conditional traps (TEQ, TGE, TLTI, ...) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: Decoded and translated missing: No test and no hardware program
ee.llsc — LL/SC, SYNC, BREAK, CACHE status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: Translated; SC checks the LL reservation; CACHE optionally patched by config missing: No hardware program names them

ee.decode — R5900 decode tables status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: All 55 ps2autotests ELFs decode and recompile; decoder fuzzed missing: Most decoded mnemonics outside MMI are not named by a hardware program (see Measurements) hardware programs: cpu_ee_alu, cpu_ee_lsu, cpu_ee_simd_shuffle, cpu_ee_fpu_arithmetic, cpu_vu0_macro_transfer
mmi.arith — Parallel add, subtract, saturate, abs, min/max status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_simd_arithmetic
mmi.compare — Parallel compare status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_simd_compare
mmi.logic — Parallel logic, shifts, PLZCW status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_simd_logic

mmi.muldiv — Parallel multiply/divide, 128-bit HI/LO status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: PMULTH family, PMADD/PMSUB accumulators, PDIV*, PMFHL/PMTHL forms hardware programs: cpu_ee_simd_muldiv real-PS2 vectors: MMI halfword and word multiplies match real-PS2 results; PDIVW, PDIVUW and PDIVBW match real-PS2 results
mmi.shuffle — Pack, extend, interleave, shuffle status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_simd_shuffle
mmi.unexercised — MMI MSUB/MSUBU status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: Decoded and translated missing: Not named by any hardware program
cop0.regs — COP0 registers (MFC0/MTC0) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: Status, Cause, EPC, Count, Compare, BadVAddr, Config, ... missing: No hardware program for the register file

cop0.perf — Performance counters (PCCR, PCR0/1) status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Masks, CTE, events and modes as the hardware program reads them missing: Event counts are derived from the runtime's cycle model, not measured hardware timing hardware programs: cpu_ee_cop0_performance
cop0.count — Count/Compare timer interrupt status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED missing: No test of the Compare interrupt

cop0.exc — Exception entry, EPC/BD, BEV vectors status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: raiseCop0Exception sets Cause, EPC (branch PC + BD in delay slots), vectors missing: No hardware program for exception entry

cop0.adderr — Address-error exceptions status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: Misaligned runtime loads raise EXCEPTION_ADDRESS_ERROR_LOAD/STORE missing: Fast-path memory helpers do not check alignment; no hardware program

cop0.intr — Interrupt enable, ERET, INTC dispatch order status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: EI/DI/ERET; INTC and DMAC handler chains in kernel order hardware programs: kernel_ee_interrupt_intc_order, kernel_ee_interrupt_dmac_order

cop0.bc0 — BC0F/BC0T (DMAC CPCOND) status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL missing: COP0 instructions are not in the automated measurement; branch-likely forms not shown to be exercised hardware programs: dma_dmac_cpcond

cop0.tlb — TLB (48 entries) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: TLBR/TLBWI/TLBWR/TLBP read and write the entry table missing: No TLB-mapped address translation or refill/invalid exceptions; no test
cop0.cache — Instruction/data cache model status: MISSING missing: CACHE ops are translated without a cache model; coherency effects are not emulated

fpu.arith — ADD/SUB/ABS/NEG/MOV/MAX/MIN, ADDA/SUBA status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE implemented: PS2 float format: exponent 255 is a number, saturation to 0x7FFFFFFF, flush below 2^-126 hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_arithmetic real-PS2 vectors: FPU results match the PS2 hardware results from ps2autotests
fpu.muldiv — MUL/DIV, MADD/MSUB, MULA/MADDA/MSUBA status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_muldiv
fpu.sqrt — SQRT.S status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: SQRT.S rows of the program match missing: Its program also contains the RSQRT.S rows that mismatch hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_sqrt

fpu.rsqrt — RSQRT.S rounding status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Sign and special cases as hardware; most rows exact missing: 7 of 66 program lines differ by 1 ulp; no pre-registered datapath model fits hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_sqrt blocker: Needs new hardware rows: probe P3 run on a physical PS2
fpu.compare — C.F/C.EQ/C.LT/C.LE status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_compare
fpu.branch — BC1F/BC1T/BC1FL/BC1TL status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_branch, cpu_ee_fpu_branchdelay
fpu.convert — CVT.S.W / CVT.W.S status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_convert
fpu.transfer — MFC1/MTC1/CFC1/CTC1/LWC1/SWC1 status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_transfer

fpu.flags — FCR31 flags and non-IEEE rounding status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Reset value, writable bits, O/U/D/I flag situations as measured missing: RSQRT.S rounding unknown (fpu.rsqrt) hardware programs: cpu_ee_fpu_fcr

ee.timer03 — EE timers T0-T3 (COUNT/MODE/COMP/HOLD) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: Counters advance from scheduler cycles; compare/overflow raise INTC missing: No hardware program; host-time driven

g.title: k.threads — Threads: create, start, sleep, suspend, terminate status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Cooperative scheduler with absolute priority and FIFO; all tested syscalls match hardware missing: Preemption timing is not cycle-exact hardware programs: kernel_ee_thread_delete, kernel_ee_thread_exit, kernel_ee_thread_resume, kernel_ee_thread_sleep, kernel_ee_thread_stat, kernel_ee_thread_suspend, kernel_ee_thread_terminate, kernel_ee_thread_wakeup

vu0.fmac — Macro FMAC arithmetic (VADD, VMUL, VMADD, ...) status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Shared FMAC contract with micro mode, anchored on real-PS2 results missing: Most macro FMAC mnemonics are not named by a hardware program (9 of 128 confirmed) real-PS2 vectors: FMAC contract anchors from real-PS2 results
vu0.int — Macro integer ops (VIADD, VIAND, ...) status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_vu0_macro_integer
vu0.xfer — QMFC2/QMTC2/CFC2/CTC2/LQC2/SQC2 status: VERIFIED_COMPLETE hardware programs: cpu_vu0_macro_transfer
vu0.mem — Macro VU memory ops (VLQI, VSQD, VILWR, ...) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED
vu0.flags — Macro MAC/STATUS/CLIP flags status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED missing: Probe P5 prepared, never run on hardware blocker: Physical PS2 + ps2sdk to run probe P5
vu0.fdiv — Macro VDIV/VSQRT/VRSQRT status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED missing: No hardware program in macro mode

svg.text: Transfer modes and control (9 · 0 ok · 5 part)

g.title: dma.normal — Normal (burst) mode, MADR/QWC write-back status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL hardware programs: dma_spr_normal

dma.chain — Source chain tags (REFE, CNT, NEXT, REF, REFS, END) status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Tag walk, TTE, terminal-tag latching, cycle detection (F2) hardware programs: dma_spr_chain, dma_dmac_tagintr
dma.callret — CALL/RET and ASR0/ASR1 status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED missing: No hardware program uses CALL/RET

dma.interleave — Interleave mode (SQWC/TQWC) status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: Skip/transfer qword counts for both scratchpad directions missing: Scope not enumerated by the automated measurement; one matching program, coverage of every case not checked hardware programs: dma_spr_interleave

dma.irq — DMA interrupts (D_STAT CIS/SIS, tag IRQ, TIE) status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL implemented: CIS0-9, SIS, MEIS, BEIS clear on write-one; CIM, SIM, MEIM toggle; INT1 when a masked status bit is set; tag IRQ and TIE hardware programs: dma_dmac_tagintr, kernel_ee_interrupt_dmac_order
dma.ctrl — D_CTRL, D_PCR, D_ENABLER/W status: VERIFIED_PARTIAL hardware programs: dma_dmac_cpcond

dma.stall — Stall control (STS/STD, D_STADR) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: fromSPR (STS=2) leaves its MADR in D_STADR after normal or interleave transfers; the VIF1 (STD=1) or GIF (STD=2) drain waits before a REFS tag or a normal-mode transfer that would read past D_STADR, stays active (STR, no CIS), raises SIS once per stall and resumes when D_STADR or D_CTRL changes missing: No hardware program; whole-tag/whole-transfer granularity (the references differ, D-DMA-4); SIF0 and fromIPU sources, the SIF1 drain and fromSPR destination-chain CNTS are not modelled blocker: Stall-control probe on a physical PS2 (docs/engineering/PS2_HARDWARE_VERIFICATION.md); SIF0/SIF1/fromIPU channel models

dma.mfifo — MFIFO ring (D_RBOR/D_RBSR) status: IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED implemented: fromSPR writes into the D_RBOR/D_RBSR ring; the GIF (MFD=3) or VIF1 (MFD=2) source chain drains it with wrapping, stalls at the write position with D_STAT.MEIS and resumes when fromSPR adds data missing: No hardware program; stall granularity is one tag (the hardware can stop inside the data, D-DMA-2); fromSPR interleave and chain modes into the ring are not wrapped blocker: MFIFO probe on a physical PS2 (docs/engineering/PS2_HARDWARE_VERIFICATION.md)
dma.timing — Bus arbitration, priority, timing status: HLE_OR_STUB implemented: Transfers complete synchronously when started missing: No bus arbitration or transfer timing
